assertions.assertion: Code defines a GoogleIdentityProvider class that extends IdentityProvider with a 'google' provider type constant
assertions.rationale: GoogleIdentityProvider : IdentityProvider defines const string ProviderType = "google" and passes it to base(ProviderType).

assertions.assertion: GoogleIdentityProvider uses the indexer pattern (this["ClientId"]) for property storage
assertions.rationale: The class uses plain auto-properties (public string? ClientId { get; set; }) instead of the base IdentityProvider string indexer, so custom values won't round-trip through the store's Properties bag.

assertions.assertion: Program.cs calls AddProviderType with GoogleHandler, GoogleOptions, and GoogleIdentityProvider type parameters
Code includes a ConfigureAuthenticationOptions-derived class that maps GoogleIdentityProvider properties to GoogleOptions
assertions.rationale: GoogleConfigureOptions derives from ConfigureAuthenticationOptions<GoogleOptions, GoogleIdentityProvider> and maps ClientId/ClientSecret.

assertions.assertion: The configure class sets SignInScheme and CallbackPath on the GoogleOptions
assertions.rationale: Configure sets options.SignInScheme and options.CallbackPath = context.PathPrefix + "/signin".
